Name: FarmQueue
Author: MLD210
Description:
[left][center][b][size=6]Farm Queue[/size][/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=4]Draw a rectangle. Your farmer does the rest.[/size][/center]

[size=5][b]What is this?[/b][/size]

Farm Queue lets you select an area of your farm by dragging a rectangle, and then your farmer automatically walks over and completes every job inside it with the tool you are holding.

No more clicking tile by tile. No more walking back and forth to refill your watering can. No more forgetting which corner of the field you already finished.

Hold an item, hold [b]LeftControl[/b], drag a box, let go. That's it.

[size=5][b]Inspired by ActionQueue Reborn[/b][/size]

This mod is directly inspired by [b]ActionQueue Reborn[/b] for [i]Don't Starve Together[/i].

In DST, ActionQueue Reborn lets you queue up a chain of actions and then watch your character execute them one by one — a small quality-of-life idea that completely changes how the game feels to play. Stardew Valley has a very similar problem: farming is repetitive, and most of the friction is not in deciding what to do, but in physically performing the same click hundreds of times.

Farm Queue brings that same idea to Stardew Valley. Instead of queueing a list of individual actions, you simply paint the area you want worked, and the queue works out the rest — which tile to visit first, how much to charge the hoe, when to walk around an obstacle, and how to get to a water source without being told.

All credit for the original concept goes to the ActionQueue Reborn author. This is a Stardew Valley interpretation of that idea.

[size=5][b]How it works[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Equip the tool or item you want to use.[/*]
[*]Hold [b]LeftControl[/b] and drag with the [b]left mouse button[/b] to paint a rectangle over the ground.[/*]
[*]Tiles are highlighted as you drag:
[list]
[*][b]Green[/b] — this tile has a job your held item can do.[/*]
[*][b]Red[/b] — nothing to do here with this item (already finished, wrong tool, blocked, out of sprinkler range, etc.).[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*]Release the mouse button. The queue starts.[/*]
[/list]Your farmer then walks to each valid tile and performs the action. Charged tools automatically use the widest charge level that stays inside the area you painted — the mod will never till outside your rectangle.

[b]Pausing[/b]

Press any movement key ([b]WASD[/b] / arrow keys) at any time to stop the queue. Opening a menu, switching tools, or alt-tabbing also pauses it safely.

[size=5][b]What each tool can do[/b][/size]


[table][tr][th]Held item[/th]
[th]Queued actions[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Hoe[/b][/td]
[td]Till soil, clear weeds, dig artifact spots and seed spots[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Watering Can[/b][/td]
[td]Water crops. Walks to a water source and refills automatically when empty[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Seeds[/b][/td]
[td]Sow on tilled soil, including trellis crops like hops and grapes[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Fertilizer[/b][/td]
[td]Apply to tilled soil[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Sapling[/b][/td]
[td]Plant fruit trees and other saplings[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Scythe[/b][/td]
[td]Cut grass and harvest scythe-able crops[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Pickaxe[/b][/td]
[td]Break stones, ore nodes, geodes, weeds, fences and boulders; flatten unwanted tilled soil[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Axe[/b][/td]
[td]Chop trees, stumps, logs and bushes[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Sprinkler[/b][/td]
[td]Place sprinklers on a planned grid[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Machine input[/b][/td]
[td]Walk to machines and load them (kegs, furnaces, preserves jars, …)[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Other placeable objects[/b][/td]
[td]Place them on the ground[/td]
[/tr]
[/table][size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Charge matching[/b] — charged tools pick the largest charge that does not spill outside your selection. No accidental extra tilling.[/*]
[*][b]Automatic refill[/b] — the watering can walks to the nearest water source and refills without being asked, then resumes exactly where it left off.[/*]
[*][b]Sprinkler-aware filtering[/b] — optionally restrict tilling or sowing to only the tiles your sprinklers actually cover.[/*]
[*][b]Smart placement order[/b] — for seeds and objects, the mod plans placements so your farmer does not trap themselves between solid objects.[/*]
[*][b]Per-tool toggles[/b] — decide exactly which jobs the queue is allowed to do with each tool.[/*]
[*][b]Idle-only machine loading[/b] — never touches a machine that is still processing or already finished.[/*]
[*][b]Layout presets[/b] — sprinkler grid layouts, including a dedicated trellis-crop layout with configurable spacing.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.0.0[/url] or newer.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]Your Mods folder should then look like this:

[code]
Mods/
└── FarmQueue/
    ├── FarmQueue.dll
    ├── manifest.json
    └── i18n/
        ├── default.json
        └── zh.json[/code][size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

Open [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] (GMCM) and click the cog next to [i]Farm Queue[/i]. Every behavior can be switched on or off per tool, so you can keep the queue strictly to the jobs you actually want automated.

The menu is organised into sections:

[list]
[*][b]General[/b] — stamina floor, walk timeout, charge speed[/*]
[*][b]Hoe[/b] — what counts as a job, sprinkler-range-only tilling[/*]
[*][b]Watering Can[/b] — water only planted crops, auto-refill behavior[/*]
[*][b]Seeds[/b] — sprinkler-range-only sowing[/*]
[*][b]Scythe / Pickaxe / Axe[/b] — per-target toggles[/*]
[*][b]Machine loading[/b] — idle machines only[/*]
[*][b]Sprinklers[/b] — grid layout[/*]
[*][b]Layout[/b] — sprinkler spacing for trellis-crop layouts[/*]
[/list]All menu labels, on-screen status text and action names follow your [b]game language[/b] automatically. English and Chinese are built in; other languages fall back to English.

[size=5][b]Translations[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]English[/*]
[*]简体中文 (Simplified Chinese)[/*]
[/list]The mod follows your [b]game language[/b] automatically. English and Simplified Chinese are included; other languages fall back to English. To add a language, drop a new file into the [font=Courier New]i18n[/font] folder.

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.0.0[/url] or newer[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] — optional, strongly recommended[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

Works alongside most SMAPI mods. It operates through the same hooks the game itself uses (tool usage, item placement, machine loading), so mods that change those systems should behave normally.

If you find a conflict, please report it with your SMAPI log — it is the fastest way to diagnose compatibility issues.

[size=5][b]Feedback[/b][/size]

Bug reports and suggestions are very welcome. If something goes wrong, please include:

[list]
[*]What you were doing (which tool, which area)[/*]
[*]Your [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url][/*]
[*]A description of what you expected vs. what happened[/*]
